name: Glacier Gate
author: Riftforge
description: Co-op maze TD. Build towers anywhere on the snowfield to shape the invaders' route. Don't fully block the path! 24 waves; survive them all.

name: Ember Rift
author: Riftforge
description: Three lanes, two teams, one Rift Core each. Pick a hero, push with your minions (siege rams join every third wave), farm jungle camps, buy items and destroy the enemy core. Up to 3v3 — bots fill empty slots.

name: Last Light
author: Riftforge
description: Co-op survival for 1-4 heroes. Shades pour in from every corner to snuff out the Sun Beacon. Hold for 15 waves and defeat the Abyss Tyrant.
